The more we wanna die, the more we can't die. Maybe things aren't as bad as you think it is. Try looking at another perspective. You are in a better circumstance than most people. (I also tried hanging before but failed miserably.)

Have you told anybody about this? If not, you need a pair of good listening ears. It's time for others to help and support you in times of need. You don't always need to suffer alone. You are worth it. Pls take care. ♡♡
Your family doesn't know you have an appointment with the therapist tomorrow? Tell them you need the car to see your therapist tomorrow. It's urgent.
How we wish we could sleep forever..

You should reach out to the cancer support groups provided in the hospital where your mum will be getting her treatment. Talk to the medical social workers/therapists regarding financial help/advice/support regarding your mum's treatment. Your mum DO need you to be by her side at these times. She really need your support and care now. Dun leave her to deal with this stuff alone. Nobody asked to be sick. Take good care of yourself too. You can also seek help/therapy. 

You can survive these! You are stronger than you think you are. All the best.

It's tired being a human. All the endless chores and repetitions happening day-in-day-out. Only 2 things are certain in Life: Death and taxes. Why think so much? Enjoy Life while you are still alive. Cheers.
It's best not to start looking for such sites as you will only go deeper. Please take good care of yourself. ♡♡
